## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant simulator or data tests pass
- [ ] Frontend production build passes when UI code changed
- [ ] Docker smoke and scenario checks pass when integration behavior changed
- [ ] Documentation and provenance records are updated where necessary
- [ ] No credentials, private operational data or generated local files are included

## Model integrity

- [ ] Synthetic results remain clearly labelled
- [ ] Units, scenario semantics and mass-balance behavior are preserved
- [ ] New data or assets include their source and license
